value.rationale: Mixed pairwise-graph and global triadic synchronization is motivated by the initiating 2026 study. The model-specific Green-diagonal threshold gives a complete sharp local stability decision for every equal-block one-bridge graph, and exposes a structural impossibility (long paths) versus attainable two-state attraction on all two-clique barbells, with explicit asymptotic gain. The contrast is invariant under graph-size scaling and neither an arbitrary parameter slice nor merely a numeric check. It does not purport to solve general finite-size random-graph transitions.
